## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link the issue; identify any stacked PR dependency.

## Contract and compatibility

List affected parameters, permissions, lifecycle, usage, resources, or host baseline. Write "none" if unchanged.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Regression coverage and docs/examples updated where applicable
- [ ] User-visible changes recorded under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`

Include actual results and manual-validation gaps. Do not equate fake inference with TUI/provider/platform verification.

## Scope check

- [ ] No credentials, private prompts/reports, generated test artifacts, or local installation records
- [ ] No unrequested release, tag, publication, active-installation change, or unrelated work
